reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, category_id, launch_date,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY launch_date NULLS LAST, product_id) AS launch_order
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, p.launch_date,
       1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p2
            WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id
              AND (p2.launch_date < p.launch_date
                   OR (p2.launch_date = p.launch_date AND p2.product_id < p.product_id)
                   OR (p.launch_date IS NULL AND p2.launch_date IS NOT NULL)
                   OR (p.launch_date IS NULL AND p2.launch_date IS NULL AND p2.product_id < p.product_id))) AS launch_order
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6

SELECT product_id, category_id, launch_date,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY COALESCE(launch_date, DATE '9999-12-31'), product_id) AS launch_order
FROM products
WHERE category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 6

other_way.tradeoff: Counting the earlier launches by hand works without windows, but the missing dates and the tie-break make the condition long.
